title: Optimize hybrid RRF top-k search
constraints: Preserve descending RRF score result ordering
rationale: FusionStorage::hybrid_search fused BM25 and vector results into a score map, fully sorted all fused candidates, and only then returned the requested limit. A limit-aware top-k partition avoids ordering candidates that will not be returned while preserving final output order.
steps: Use select_nth_unstable_by to keep only the top RRF candidates
Sort only the retained top-k candidate window
Add storage tests for bounded ordering and zero-limit behavior
expected_impact: Reduces hybrid search sorting work for small result limits.
